hero.bio: I combine hands-on operations experience with Python, SQL, forecasting, and procurement analytics to reduce cost, improve availability, and make complex supply chain decisions clearer.

about.p1: I grew up in my family’s electronics business in Mumbai, where supply chain wasn’t a subject. It was whether the shipment showed up and whether we got paid. Chasing vendors, negotiating rates, fixing stockouts: that was daily life long before I had textbook words for any of it.
about.p2: The research came later: a year spent ranking 1,500 companies for India’s first supply chain index. Then Chicago, for my MS at DePaul. These days I’m as happy writing SQL as I am on the phone with a supplier. I think that mix is the whole point.

bullets: Manage office operations: printing, scanning, communications, and call handling
Coordinate faculty requests and maintain organized workflows across multiple projects
Provide timely, responsive support to visitors, students, and faculty

experience.org: Kellstadt School of Business · DePaul University
bullets: Led 7+ recruitment events using CRM (Slate) to manage prospective student pipelines
Advised 100+ prospective students on SCM, analytics and logistics curricula and career paths
Maintained a 24-hour SLA for all applicant communication to support enrollment goals
Engaged 150+ students through live sessions, panels, and digital platforms
Managed end-to-end operations: procurement, manufacturing oversight, QC, inventory and distribution
Strategic sourcing initiatives achieved ₹200,000 in FY24 cost savings through vendor renegotiation
Reduced defect-related waste by salvaging and reprocessing PVC wire, generating ₹90,000 annual savings
Improved demand planning workflows to enhance on-time delivery performance across product lines
Analyzed 1,500+ companies across 24 sectors using R, Excel and Tableau to benchmark SC performance
Built India’s first national supply chain index, enhanced methodology by 40% over prior frameworks
Authored "Top 20 Supply Chain Champions of India", flagship industry report
Led Supply Chain Dialogue Series with CSCO-level speakers from Fortune 500 companies
SEO-optimized content strategy raised website traffic by 25% and session time by 40%
Grew Instagram account organically by 10,000+ followers through targeted campaigns
Developed high-performing content scripts and social media themes for student audiences
Evaluated supplier performance with scorecards; removed 2 underperforming vendors from approved list
Applied MRP to prevent stockouts, material availability improved by 30%
Scheduled outbound logistics and tracked 20+ weekly shipments ensuring on-time delivery

projects.title: Retail Demand Forecasting
projects.desc: Team ML project on retail store inventory data: EDA and feature engineering across inventory levels, orders, pricing and discounts, then trained and compared models to forecast units sold and flag replenishment risk.

projects.title: Inbound Truckload RFP
projects.desc: Worked a real 2024 inbound TL RFP for KeHE Distributors in DePaul’s transportation practicum, analyzed lane-level carrier bids and built an award recommendation balancing cost, coverage and service.

projects.title: AI-Automated SC Analytics
projects.desc: End-to-end analytics stack built solo: a Supabase Postgres warehouse, Quadratic AI spreadsheets for analysis, and n8n workflow automation wiring supply chain datasets to automated Gmail alerts.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation
projects.desc: K-Means clustering over income, spending score and channel mix to carve a retail customer base into actionable segments, elbow-method validation and a tailored loyalty-program play per cluster.

projects.title: Churn Prediction Model
projects.desc: Decision-tree classifier on tenure, charges, support calls and contract type, tuned depth and leaf size, then translated the tree’s splits into concrete retention actions for at-risk customers.

projects.title: Optimization in Excel
projects.desc: Linear-programming production models (M&D Chemicals) and decision-analysis labs in Excel Solver: formulating constraints, reading sensitivity reports and running what-if scenarios on cost and capacity.

writing.title: A Day in the Life of an MS in Supply Chain Management Student
writing.desc: My published piece on the Kellstadt blog — the train commute to the Loop Campus, collaborative study sessions, evening classes, and the transportation optimization model I built integrating demand, capacity uncertainty and cost-risk tradeoffs.

writing.title: Top 20 Supply Chain Champions of India
writing.desc: India’s first national supply chain index — I analyzed 1,500+ public companies across 24 sectors and helped build the ranking methodology blending financial metrics with ESG, resilience and technology factors.

writing.title: What a Live Truckload RFP Taught Me About Carrier Pricing
writing.desc: The cheapest lane bid is rarely the cheapest lane. Working KeHE’s real 2024 inbound RFP data, I learned why buyers pay premiums on purpose, and what a bid sheet doesn’t tell you.

writing.title: Ranking 1,500 Companies: Building India’s First Supply Chain Index
writing.desc: How do you compare a pharma cold chain to a cement dispatch network? Behind the methodology of the Top 20 Supply Chain Champions of India, and what almost broke it.

writing.title: I Built an ERP Solo to Understand the Systems I’ll Manage
writing.desc: Most supply chain people can drive an ERP. I wanted to know what’s under the hood, so I built one with Django, Python and SQL, and it changed how I think about every system I’ll ever use.
